sloka: तान् भूमौ पतितान् दृष्ट्वा क्षणेन एव महाजवान् ।रामस्य च महत् कर्म महान् त्रासो अभवन् मम ॥३-२१-१०॥
transliteration: tān bhūmau patitān dṛṣṭvā kṣaṇena eva mahājavān ।rāmasya ca mahat karma mahān trāso abhavan mama ॥3-21-10॥

translations.english: Seeing the powerful demons collapse on the ground in a moment's time through Rama's action, I was frightened.
